name: site
title: Site details
description: The business's details, entered once. Sections show them wherever a field is bound to one (the header's phone number, the footer's small print), unless that block says something else.

tagline.label: About line
tagline.help: One line on what you do and where: the footer shows it.

hours.label: Opening hours
hours.help: One line a day or range: "Mon to Fri 8am to 6pm".

review_summary.label: Review summary
review_summary.help: "**4.9** from 120 Google reviews": keep it true and up to date.

small_print.label: Small print
small_print.help: The legal name, company number and registered office: UK companies must show these on their website.
